ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 20-25% high-intensity (white) regions concentrated primarily on the left lobe and as discrete focal points across both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity patch on the distal half of the left lobe. Dense heterogeneous mottling across both lobes with high-contrast circular white blobs distributed across the dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 45-50 degrees and a defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the posterior margins of both lobes, tapering to acute points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive distribution of small, circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (barnacle attachment sites) across the entire ventral surface, particularly dense along the midline and trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, near-vertical linear disruptions visible within the high-intensity white patch on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization across the visible surface; irregular notched appearance of the trailing edge suggesting minor historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced cluster of high-contrast white barnacles on the extreme lateral margin of the right fluke tip.
